It therefore processes the flat-bottom case rather than the enclosing vessel-types comparison case.

Cross-file shape assumption across L14-L22 and L37-L41: coordinates are derived only from eta_00001, but selected eta arrays are not checked for matching dimensions.
The independent nfile and sec lists at L24-L25 are jointly indexed at L35 and L43 without an equal-length check; editing only one can make sec[num] out of range.
